name: HESEIA
description: HESEIA is a large dataset of 46,499 sentences designed to evaluate social biases in large language models, co-created with high-school teachers and students from Latin America. It captures intersectional biases across multiple demographic axes and school subjects, reflecting local contexts and pedagogical expertise to better assess stereotype recognition in LLMs.
reputation: A recent, socially grounded bias benchmark co-created with educators and students, with growing interest for evaluating intersectional bias in LLMs.
notes: Dataset created with participatory approach involving educators and students; focuses on intersectional social biases in Latin American educational contexts.
